thread:
Ashley (support): quick heads-up — customer reported the API call succeeded but the system applied an account adjustment instead of issuing a refund. they expected $42.00 refunded to card.
Ashley (support): payload they sent below (redacted card):
```json
{
  "user_id": "acct_ABC123",
  "intent": "refund",
  "amount": "42.00",
  "currency": "USD"
}
```
Ashley (support): router logs show tool selection favored `billing.adjust_account` not `refund.create`. snippet: 
```
router: candidate_scores = {billing.adjust_account:0.78, refund.create:0.45, note.create:0.10}
resolution: selected=billing.adjust_account
```
Jordan (platform): yikes. was this via chat-invoke or direct function-call flow?
Ashley (support): direct API call to /invoke with tools allowed = [refund.create, billing.adjust_account, note.create]. model=redwood-chat-1
Priya (ml): hunch: amount passed as string may have triggered a fuzzy-schema match to adjust_account (it accepts freeform notes+string amounts). refund.create expects numeric amount in schema so the schema matcher penalized it.
Sam (eng): can repro locally with similar payload. quick repro: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -d '{"tool_candidates":["refund.create","billing.adjust_account"],"input":"refund 42 dollars","payload":{"amount":"42.00","user_id":"acct_TEST"}}'
```
Sam (eng): router trace shows we do type-coercion scoring: string->number mismatch = -0.4, but we also have a bias for fewer required fields which favored adjust_account.
Jordan (platform): ok two problems: (1) schema matcher is too forgiving on signature overlap, (2) we don't honor explicit intent field strongly enough.
Priya (ml): quick mitigation: bump exact-operation-signal when payload contains key `intent` set to "refund". that should make refund.create jump above threshold.
Sam (eng): agree. also add a stricter schema validation step before execution that returns 4xx instead of auto-falling back. customers expect error not silent substitution.
Ashley (support): customer wants escalated — they already saw account adjustment applied and asked for reversal + refund. filing a ticket.
Jordan (platform): priority P1 for rollback/reconcile automation and P2 for router fix. @OpsBot start incident runbook? :loud_sound:
OpsBot: Incident created INC-2025-329, paging oncall. runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/router-fallback
Priya (ml): proposed short-term patch: if payload.intent in ["refund","chargeback"] then require candidate with op_name containing "refund" to have +0.6 bonus. will open PR.
Sam (eng): I'll add a validation hook to return 400 when numeric fields are strings for strict routes. small change, can ship in next patch window.
Jordan (platform): also add a log metric for "silent-tool-substitution" so we can alert when selection != explicit op requested.
Ashley (support): thanks — customer update: told them we reversed the adjustment and processing true refund, will confirm once funds appear.
Jordan (platform): follow-ups: 1) PR for intent-biasing 2) validation hook + test 3) metric + alert 4) patch release note. assign owners?

Sam (eng): I'll do 2 and 3.
